mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! If you've ever wondered what it really takes to build a life that fits who you are—one that feels intentional, meaningful, and truly your own—you're in the right place. Imagine living each day not by accident, but by design. That's exactly the invitation at the heart of Designing Your Life: Build a Life that Works for You, brought to us by Bill Burnett. Instead of following a narrow, predetermined path, what if you could approach your life the way a designer approaches a new project—curious, open-minded, and ready to experiment? Here, we’ll explore how challenges can actually become stepping stones, and how even uncertainty turns into an opportunity for creative problem-solving. Think of it like the process of design thinking—where you’re encouraged to try things out, test ideas, and learn from what doesn’t work, just as much as what does. As we dive in, you’ll notice the lines between work, play, and purpose start to blur, opening up new ways to find meaning and satisfaction in everything you do. Rather than searching for one “right” answer, together we’ll discover how to uncover many different paths, each shaped by your own values, interests, and experiences. By weaving the principles of design into the choices you make every day, you’ll begin to feel a new sense of freedom and resilience—empowering you to shape a life that’s truly, authentically yours. So, as we set off on this journey, get ready for practical steps, fresh perspectives, and a little bit of adventure. Let’s explore how you can start designing a life that’s not just successful, but deeply rewarding—one choice at a time.
